description: Trend Agent: picks today's trends — search surges (Google/X), viral videos (TikTok/Instagram), memes and commercially cleared TikTok sounds with a filming script — that fit the user's business category, country and language, and returns a tailored hook and content idea for each. Markets: US, GB, SE, GR. Use before writing a trend-based post, meme or video script.

country.description: Override the market. Defaults to the market resolved from the business profile.

days.description: How many days back to look (default 3)

feedType.description: search = Google/X search surges, video = TikTok/Instagram clips with a filmable audio+visual formula, meme = image/GIF formats with a template, audio = commercially cleared TikTok sounds (original dialogue, CC0, ASMR) with a filming script

focus.description: Extra steer, e.g. 'we launch a summer menu' or 'B2B only'

includeCreatorOnly.description: Also consider trends the scout marked 'Creator Only' or 'Avoid' for brands (default: brand-safe only)

platform.description: Only trends seen on this platform

name: find_trends_for_business
title: Find Trends for This Business
